translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content.text: Bila mbi makanda mafuemini e ?
Bila mbi batu balembo yindudila
mambu makambulu fuana e ?
Bila mbi mintinu mi ntoto mitelimini e ?
Bila mbi minyadi mikutikinini va kimosi mu nuanisa Yave
ayi mutu andi kavinda mafuta e ?
Balembo tubi : “tuzenganu minsinga miawu ;
tulozanu thama zisieni ziawu.”
Mutu wowo wunkalanga ku Diyilu wulembo sevi.
Pfumu wulembo basekinina.
Bosi wulembo bayolukila mu nganzi andi,
ayi wulembo kuba monisa tsisi mu miangu miandi mi ngolo.
Ayi wutuba : “Minu ndibieka ntinu ama ku Sioni,
mongo ama wunlongo.”
Ndiela yamikisa lukanu lu Pfumu :
Yave wukhamba : “Ngeyo widi muanꞌama.
Minu ndibutidi mu lumbu kiaki.”
Wundombi ayi mandivana makanda ;
ma maba kiuka kiaku
ayi mawu vua ntoto wumvimba nate mu sukisina ntoto beni.
Wela kuba yadilanga mu nkawa wu sengo ;
wela kuba bula banga bu mbudikilanga nzungu yi tuma.
Diawu, beno mintinu, bika luba nduenga.
Bosi beno mazuzi ma ntoto, bika lutambula ndongokolo ;
lusadila Yave mu lukinzu
ayi lumona khini mu lukhuku.
Lubumbakana muana mu diambu di kedi fuema ;
ayi luedi bungana mu nzilꞌeno.
Bila mu mbuetolo yi meso nganzi andi yilenda vika wulama.
Lusakumunu kuidi batu boso bobo bantombanga suamunu mu niandi.
